title: Is It a.m. or p.m.? PLC Activity

stageA.sourceMathematics: a.m. is the time from midnight before noon, p.m. from noon until midnight. The SAME 2:00 analog clock may represent2 a.m. or2 p.m.; context alone can give several plausible daily schedules.
stageA.studentFacingAuthenticTask: Original students label do homework, get ready for bed, eat lunch, go to school, sleep with a.m. or p.m., CONNECT to plausible original publisher clock and DRAW hands. Valid family routines vary; avoid fixed universal time grading.
stageA.originalMediaAndHumanLimits: Teacher reviews personal schedule context, original image labels and plausible alternate time arrangements.
